advancement.scythes.super_necromancer.de: Summon ${balance:Progression.MINION_ARMY_SIZE|number} withering skeletons at the same time.
tooltip.scythes.withering_minion.desc: Right click in the air summons a nearby wither-skeleton minion for ${balance:Withering.MINION_DURABILITY_COST|number} durability and ${balance:Withering.MINION_SOUL_COST|number} souls. Minions follow their owner, defend them, are immune to fire, passively regenerate by consuming scythe durability, and feed souls from their kills back into the owner's Withering Scythe. When dismissed or when their ${balance:Minion.LIFETIME_TICKS|minutes}-minute lifetime expires, they refund souls in proportion to their remaining health, rounded down. Shift+right click dismisses all of your minions.
